🚨 KILLMOENEWSWIRE | CRITICAL COLLISION ON NEW YORK AVENUE N.E.

WASHINGTON, D.C.
Date: January 17, 2026
Time: Approximately 1:42 a.m.
Location: 3500 block of New York Avenue, N.E.

Metropolitan Police and DC Fire and EMS are on scene of a critical traffic collision involving an overturned vehicle in the 3500 block of New York Avenue, Northeast.

According to officials, an adult male was transported to an area hospital with life-threatening injuries. Emergency crews remain on scene conducting their investigation and managing traffic impacts.

🚧 Traffic Advisory
•Expect lane closures and traffic delays
•Drivers are advised to seek alternate routes

The cause of the crash remains under investigation.

SUNOG SA ISANG COMMERCIAL COMPLEX SA PASIG CITY

Fire under control na ang sunog na sumiklab sa isang commercial complex sa Brgy. Ugong, Pasig City, as of 3:10 PM, Jan. 18, 2026.

Itinaas sa ikalawang alarma ang sunog bago ito tuluyang maapula, ayon kay YouScooper Cristopher Manzon na bahagi ng Kapasigan Fire and Rescue “Delta."

Patuloy ang imbestigasyon ng mga awtoridad sa sanhi ng sunog. #YouScoop

COURTESY: YouScooper Cristopher Manzon
